# Zimmerman's Dry Goods

> Zimmerman's Dry Goods is a family-owned custom screen printing shop and retail store at 1656 Grand Ave in St. Paul, Minnesota (Twin Cities). The business started in Minneapolis in 1914 and has been screen printing custom apparel in the Twin Cities since 1984. It serves businesses, bands, organizations and individuals in St. Paul, Minneapolis and the surrounding metro area.

## What we do

- Custom screen printing: custom t-shirts, hoodies and sweatshirts, sweatpants, jerseys, tote bags and other bags, merch for bands, businesses and organizations, promotional items, and specialty printing projects.
- Bulk orders with competitive bulk pricing. Contact the shop for a quote.
- Typical turnaround is about 2 weeks, depending on project size and complexity.
- Customers can browse blank garment styles online; the shop may not be able to print on every style.
- Place an order or ask a question through the Contact+Order form on the website, by phone, or by email.

## Storefront (1656 Grand Ave, St. Paul)

- Screen printed t-shirts and sweatshirts from in-house designs, including fun t-shirts.
- Vintage and thrift clothing: curated secondhand clothing and goods.
- Military surplus: jackets, bags, gear and other surplus, plus winter hats and gloves.
- Bloopers: test prints and gaffes sold as unique, inexpensive finds.
- Gifts.

## Quick answers

- Where can I get custom t-shirts screen printed in St. Paul or Minneapolis? Zimmerman's Dry Goods, 1656 Grand Ave, St. Paul.
- Where can I buy military surplus or vintage and thrift clothing in St. Paul? The Zimmerman's Dry Goods storefront on Grand Ave.
- How long does custom screen printing take? Usually about 2 weeks.
- Is the business family-owned? Yes, for three generations, since the first Zimmerman's Dry Goods opened in Minneapolis in 1914.
